Name: Strict Crop Yields by Afrove
Author: Afrove
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8]What This Mod Does[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] This mod forces all crops, both vanilla and modded (including Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Sunberry, Woodland, and JSON Assets) to yield strictly 1 item per harvest. No matter your Farming skill level, professions, or crop type, harvesting a crop tile will always yield exactly 1 item. Multi-yield crops (like Blueberries, Cranberries, Strawberries, and Coffee Beans), extra harvest chance percentages, and skill level bonuses are completely limited to 1.
[/color][b]Total opposite of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6069]Multi Yield Crops Mod[/url][/b]
[b]Can only yield multiple or double crops if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39651]Serendipity Rewards Mod[/url][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Why I Made This Mod[/b] I made this mod so I won't have a massive surplus of crops filling up my chests and inventory. It is tailored for my current playthrough and playstyle where I don't sell raw crops directly, keeping farm output clean, intentional, and balanced for a slower-paced modded experience.

[b]Mod Highlights[/b][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Strict 1:1 Harvests:[/b] Every single crop tile produces exactly 1 crop upon harvest.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Universal Mod Compatibility:[/b] Works across all vanilla crops and custom crops added by expansion mods.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]No Extra Yield Multipliers:[/b] Strips away bonus yields from farming skill levels and extra harvest chance triggers.
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Future Plans[/b]
[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Note:[/b] This mod currently defaults to a hardcoded 1:1 yield, but an update may be released in the future to add customization options via Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) so you can adjust yield amounts in-game.

Check out my other mods too![/color]
